We were told repeatedly that “she can’t help” or that “the surgery is closing soon, so you won’t be seen anyway.” After contacting NHS 111, they referred us to the surgery and confirmed it was the practice’s responsibility to arrange an appointment based on the referral. The receptionist even admitted she could see the referral but still refused to help, insisting that I “fill in a form” instead of arranging the care my daughter needs.

This level of indifference and lack of compassion toward a young child is unacceptable. Patients—especially children—deserve to be treated with respect and urgency.
